anchorActivity: HDFC Mutual Fund appeared in every large August 2026 anchor book verified: Shiprocket (₹727 Cr anchor, 11 Aug), Augmont Enterprises (₹246 Cr, 21 Aug) and Symbiotec Pharmalab (₹526 Cr, 21 Aug).

Symbiotec Pharmalab's ₹526 Cr anchor round (IPO 24–27 Aug, ₹1,757 Cr issue) was led by HDFC MF, ICICI Prudential MF, Motilal Oswal MF, Mirae Asset, Tata MF and Edelweiss MF, alongside Citigroup Global Markets Mauritius, BNP Paribas, Bajaj Life and Tata AIA Life.

Shiprocket's ₹727 Cr anchor book (IPO opened 12 Aug, ₹1,617 Cr issue) drew New York State Teachers Retirement System (via Goldman Sachs AM), Nomura Funds Ireland and Societe Generale, plus SBI MF, HDFC MF, Nippon India MF, Kotak MF, Mirae Asset MF, UTI MF, Motilal Oswal MF and Bandhan MF.

Augmont Enterprises raised ₹246.3 Cr from 14 anchors (IPO 21–25 Aug, ₹825 Cr issue) including Nomura Trust & Banking, HDFC MF, Nippon India MF, Tata MF, Jupiter India Fund, Lion Global, 360 ONE and Societe Generale ODI; the issue was subscribed 105.78 times and listed on 31 Aug.
Deepa Jewellers (₹459.7 Cr issue, price band ₹168–177) held its anchor bidding on 31 Aug ahead of the 1–3 Sep public subscription; anchor names were not yet published at the time of this sweep.
Mid-August ipocentral tallies showed domestic mutual funds taking about 65% of Gaja Capital's anchor book (₹550 Cr issue) and IFC plus top MFs putting ₹465 Cr into Milky Mist's anchor round.
